name: Script Temple
intro: This temple stores spells that do many steps at once.
One spell can call many commands.
Ancient scripts run as a single act.

1: A rune circle waits for a spell.
Many steps can be cast as one.
The temple loves a single, safe act.
2: A script can run Redis commands inside it.
The whole script runs without a break.
You can run a script by name.

ok: The rune circle completes. No break.
A spell cast in one breath.
error: The temple hums with a warning.
The script tripped on its own words.

curiosity: What could a spell do for you?
One script, many commands. Try it.
I wonder if it can count for you.
humor: Spells here are just very bossy scripts.
EVAL is a spell with a keyboard.
The temple does not do half-magic.
wisdom: A script keeps every step safe as one.
Teach a script once, cast it many times.
sternness: A spell needs a valid script. No shortcuts.
The rune will not bend for you.
Cast it right, or not at all.
